title: feat(plugin-form): a multi file / image field takes the whole row in the form auto-layout
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBU5y97XtBcJ8qSLSR3B3Djd)_
Fixes #34668

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgwLiKcfujYUug7sPs

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：表单自动排版里，对象字段声明 `multiple: true` 的文件 / 图片字段默认占整行；弹窗、整页表单、分页签表单、向导表单走同一条规则。单文件 / 单图仍占一格。
- **为什么改**：3 列的新建弹窗里，多图 / 多附件字段原来只占一格（测得每行 `[2, 3, 3]` 个，即与普通字段同宽）。详情页早已按同一判据让多文件字段占整行，这次表单与它对齐（裁定 6939109581「只放宽多文件附件」）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改默认宽度，不加元数据键、不改导出；spec 里 `FormField.span` 的说明文字同步改为如实描述（只改文字，不改键和取值）；作者写了 `span: 'full'` 或 `colSpan` 的照写的来（显式 `span: 'auto'` 不收窄，`colSpan: 1` 才保持一格）。回滚即还原 `autoLayout.ts` 一个提交。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts`（新增 `isWideFormField`，`resolveColSpan` 与 `twelfthsFor` 改为问它）；`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/multiFileFullRow-34668.test.tsx`；`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` 中 `FormField.span` 的一句说明。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/multiFileFullRow-34668.test.tsx`，预期 17 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts`: a module-private `isWideFormField(field)` answers the `span: 'auto'` default. It returns true for a wide type (`isWideFieldType`, unchanged), and for a `file` / `image` field (bare or `field:` spelling) whose **object field** declares `multiple: true`. This is a parallel copy of plugin-detail's `MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES` / `isWideDetailField`, with a docblock that points at it. plugin-form does not import from plugin-detail.
- `resolveColSpan` (the CSS-grid path behind `applyAutoColSpan`, `applyAutoLayout` and `sectionFormLayout`) and `twelfthsFor` (the twelve-track path of `sectionedGridLayout`) now ask `isWideFormField` where they asked `isWideFieldType`. The precedence is unchanged: `span: 'full'`, then an authored `colSpan`, then the default. The author's width still wins.
- **Where `multiple` is read.** It is read off the object-field definition that the object-bound builders stash on the FormField (`FormField.field`, set by `fromObjectSchema` and by `ObjectForm`'s flat builder). It is never read off `FormField.multiple`, which a form view entry can restate. This is the card's "只读对象字段的 `multiple`". Reading the stash means no caller had to change: every host that lays out through these helpers gets the rule, and the diff does not touch `ModalForm.tsx`, `DrawerForm.tsx`, `ObjectForm.tsx`, `TabbedForm.tsx` or `WizardForm.tsx`.
- No change to `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`, `isWideFieldType`'s signature or answer, or the package's `index.tsx` / `core.ts` exports. No metadata key is added.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/README.md`: the wide-kinds sentence names the multi-file rule.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: the `FormField.span` `.describe()` said that under `'auto'` "only textarea, markdown, html, richtext and repeater resolve to the full column count". That is no longer true, so it now reads "only textarea, markdown, html, richtext and repeater, plus a file or image field whose object field declares `multiple: true`, resolve to the full column count (…); an authored `colSpan` still wins over that default (`colSpan: 1` keeps such a field in one cell)." The colSpan clause was corrected in round 2: `resolveColSpan` and `twelfthsFor` check `span: 'full'`, then `colSpan`, then `isWideFormField` (which covers both the wide types and multi file / image). So an explicit `span: 'auto'` does not narrow any of them, and only an authored `colSpan` does. This is description text only: no schema, key, value or default changes, so `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand (L1-a REWORK 6941942506, claim amendment 6941965048). Regenerated output: `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` (the `FormField` and `FormSection.fields` rows). The JSON Schema output is gitignored, and `check:authorable-surface` regenerates it and is green.
- `.changeset/34668-form-multi-file-full-row.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch and `@objectstack/spec` patch (the description text).

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/multiFileFullRow-34668.test.tsx`, 17 tests. The rendered cases read per-row counts from the real form renderer's classes at `@md` / `@2xl` / `@4xl`, the same reading as `dialogContainerColumns-34607`.

- Acceptance 1, dialog: flat create dialog (three wide), `full` dialog (four wide), undeclared sections, the object's `fieldGroups`, and a mixed-density (twelve-track) dialog. Multi image and multi file take the row (`[1, 1, 1]`).
- Acceptance 1, page hosts: `ObjectForm` sectioned, `ObjectForm` flat (span equals the inferred grid width), `TabbedForm`, `WizardForm`.
- Acceptance 2: single image, single file and multi-value select keep one cell (`[2, 3, 3]`). An authored `colSpan: 1` keeps a multi image in one cell. `span: 'full'` still widens a single file.
- Helper layer: both spellings; only the object field is read (FormField-level `multiple` alone does not widen); `multiple` on select / lookup does nothing; authored `colSpan` wins; twelve-track twelfths; `applyAutoLayout`.
- Acceptance 3: no existing pin was edited. Before this change, no existing test in the package pinned a file / image cell width (searched for `field:file` / `field:image` in the package's tests). The full package suite is green unedited (below).

## Acceptance notes

- **View-level `multiple`.** A form view entry restating `multiple` over the object field changes the widget (`sectionFields` merges `fd.multiple`). It does not change the width, because the ruling reads the object field only. A view that turns a single-file object field into a multi-file widget therefore keeps one cell, and the author can widen it with `span: 'full'`. This follows the ruling and is recorded here, not changed.
- **`video` / `audio`.** These map to the `field:file` widget. If their object field declared `multiple: true`, they would widen in the form but not in the detail view, which matches on the raw type. The spec's multi-capable types are select / lookup / file / image, so this is not reachable through validated metadata. No card filed.
- **`ModalForm.tsx` docblock.** The `DIALOG_DEFAULT_COLUMNS` docblock lists the wide kinds via `isWideFieldType` and does not mention multi-file. It is still true as written. It was left alone because the file belongs to the sibling #34604 work.
- **Studio designer.** app-shell's `ObjectFormDesigner` previews widths with `isWideFieldType` on the raw type, so its preview does not show the multi-file rule. Not a defect class under the card. Noted only.
- **Unchanged inputs.** An inline `customFields` member, or a form mounted with no object schema, carries no stashed object field and keeps the type-only answer.

## Verification

Head: `eba9da32`, a clean merge of `origin/main` f02f4f63 into `31c82383` (no hand resolution). Since `f261912b` the plugin-form code and tests in this PR are unchanged. The blocks after the spec block were taken on `f261912b`; the merge block was taken on `eba9da32`.
